page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-16 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 126.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression tests scoring in the top 10% of tested servers. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests show average throughput, with read-only large block speeds at 50.87 GB/sec and write large block speeds at 33.92 GB/sec. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration, which assist in text processing and small-model LLM text generation, both of which achieved top-tier benchmark results.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-highmem-16 offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the added cost of bundled local storage or GPU hardware. Given its strong single-core performance and substantial memory capacity, this instance is well-suited for memory-bound applications, database operations, text processing, software compilation, and small-scale language model inference.
